title: 9. INSERT a row
prompt:
INSERT adds a row.

Add this student:

id 7, name Grace, year_group 11, house Yellow, maths_score 80

The check runs after your statement and looks at the whole students table.
starterQuery:
INSERT INTO students (id, name, year_group, house, maths_score)
VALUES
solutionQuery: INSERT INTO students (id, name, year_group, house, maths_score) VALUES (7, 'Grace', 11, 'Yellow', 80);
effectQuery: SELECT id, name, year_group, house, maths_score FROM students
